 Every live game, channel and kick-off time is in our Football on TV today guide, updated through the day.
 Getafe vs Brighton is live on TNT Sports 2 in the UK on Thursday 5 November, with kick-off at 8pm GMT. The Conference League fixture is also available to stream on HBO Max with TNT Sports access.
 What channel is Getafe vs Brighton on?
 UK viewers can watch the match on TNT Sports 2. The game is listed in the Conference League television schedule .
 Match detail Information 
 Fixture Getafe vs Brighton 
 Competition UEFA Conference League 
 Date Thursday 5 November 2026 
 UK kick-off 8pm GMT 
 UK coverage TNT Sports 2 
 Live stream HBO Max with TNT Sports access 
 How to live stream Getafe vs Brighton
 The streaming option is HBO Max. You need a plan that includes TNT Sports; an entertainment-only subscription does not provide the match.
 Advertisement 
 If you already receive TNT Sports through a TV or mobile provider, follow the provider’s activation instructions. The HBO Max help page explains the available routes.
 What time does Getafe vs Brighton kick off?
 The match starts at 8pm GMT on Thursday 5 November 2026. This is the UK kick-off time, rather than the start of the broadcaster’s build-up.
 Read more Wasteful Man City punished again as Brighton expose defensive errors → 
 Is Getafe vs Brighton free to watch?
 No free-to-air UK live broadcast is listed. You need access to TNT Sports through an eligible subscription.
